providers.title: Poincare inequality for means over coordinates
providers.scope: For a trigonometric polynomial f on T^N and a set S of coordinates, |f - E_S f|_2^2 <= (1/(4 pi^2)) times the sum over n outside S of |d_n f|_2^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Fejer means on a torus
providers.scope: The Fejer means of a bounded Borel function on T^N are trigonometric polynomials; they keep bounds a <= f <= b and the Lipschitz constant for the sup distance, commute with the means over coordinates, and converge uniformly for continuous f.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The heat operators on characters
providers.scope: P_t f(x) = E f(x + sqrt(2t) Z) satisfies P_t e_k = exp(-4 pi^2 |k|^2 t) e_k; on trigonometric polynomials P_t is a semigroup, commutes with derivatives and solves the heat equation.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The heat operator moves a function slowly in L^1
providers.scope: For a real trigonometric polynomial f on T^N: |f - P_t f|_1 <= sqrt(2t) times the sum of |d_n f|_1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Derivatives of P_t f in L^2
providers.scope: For a trigonometric polynomial f on T^N and t > 0: the sum of |d_n P_t f|_2^2 is at most |f|_2^2 / (2 e t).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Gibbs' inequality and the sign of the entropy
providers.scope: For bounded h >= 0 and a density p on a probability space, the integral of h log p is at most Ent(h); Ent(h) >= 0 and Ent(c h) = c Ent(h).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Rothaus's lemma
providers.scope: For a bounded real function g on a probability space and a real number a: Ent((a+g)^2) <= Ent(g^2) + 2 times the integral of g^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A logarithmic Sobolev inequality on the circle
providers.scope: For every real continuously differentiable function f on the circle R/Z: Ent(f^2) <= (7/4) |f'|_2^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Hypercontractivity of the heat operators on the circle
providers.scope: If 1 < p <= q and (q-1)/(p-1) <= exp(4t/c_0) with c_0 = 7/4, then |P_t f|_q <= |f|_p for every real continuous function on the circle; in particular |P_t f|_2 <= |f|_p for p = 1 + exp(-4t/c_0).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Hypercontractivity of the heat operators on a torus
providers.scope: For every N, t >= 0 and p = 1 + exp(-4t/c_0): |P_t f|_2 <= |f|_p for every real continuous function on T^N. The exponent does not depend on N.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The heat operator makes a function with small L^1 norm small in L^2
providers.scope: With b = tanh(2t/c_0) and a = 1 - b: |P_t f|_2 <= |f|_1^b |f|_2^a for real continuous f on T^N.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Juntas for trigonometric polynomials with a bounded sum of derivatives
providers.scope: For 0 < eps <= 1 there is an explicit q(eps) such that every real trigonometric polynomial f on T^N with sum |d_n f|_1 <= 1 and |f - mean|_2 <= 1 satisfies |f - E_S f|_1 < eps for the set S of the at most q(eps) coordinates with |d_n f|_1 >= eta(eps).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Lipschitz functions on a torus are close to juntas
providers.scope: Every H: T^N -> [-1,1] that is L-Lipschitz for the sup distance is within tau in L^2 of E_S H for a set S of at most J_T(L,tau) coordinates; J_T does not depend on N.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Austin's junta theorem on the cube
providers.scope: For L >= 0 and tau > 0 there is J(L,tau) such that every f: [0,1]^N -> [-1,1] with |f(x) - f(y)| <= L max |x_k - y_k| has a set S of at most J(L,tau) coordinates with |f - E_S f|_2 < tau, for every N. One can take J(L,tau) = J_T(2L,tau).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
